retrievalProfile.description: A warm, golden-hour composition featuring a large central sun disk, a silhouetted figure on a beach, and centered vintage serif typography.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist flat design is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A nostalgic 1970s-style composition dominated by a massive, glowing white sun disk centered behind a dark silhouette of a man crouching on a sandy beach, framed by warm orange and yellow atmospheric gradients.
coreVisualRelationships: Large sun disk as the primary light source and backdrop
Silhouetted figure positioned in the lower right quadrant
Centered typography in the upper third of the frame
Small bird silhouette in the upper left for balance

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A man in profile, crouching, occupies the lower right foreground at medium scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive white sun disk centered horizontally and vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bird in the top left, down to the central sun, across to the figure, and up to the centered text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive sky and beach areas filled with soft color gradients.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm yellow and orange atmospheric tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown/black for silhouettes and typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the sun disk.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the center (sun) transitioning to high saturation oranges at the edges.

letterConstructionRules: Thick vertical strokes with thin horizontal connectors
Curled or swash-like terminals on capital letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Centered stack of varying sizes using the same typeface family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the slightly weathered, classic feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle photograph of a beach at sunset with a massive, glowing white sun disk in the center. A dark silhouette of a man is crouching on the sand in the lower right. A small bird silhouette is in the top left sky. The sky is a gradient of yellow and orange.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered decorative serif text in the upper third of the image using a dark brown color. Use a large font for the main title and smaller sizes for secondary information.

verificationChecks: Is the sun disk large and white?
Is the figure a dark silhouette?
Is the typography centered and decorative?
Is the color palette warm and golden?

postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth color transitions in the sky
Ensure the sun disk is a clean circle
Verify the silhouette has sharp edges against the light
recipe.reuseFormula: Central sun disk + foreground silhouette + centered vintage serif = 70s cinematic nostalgia.
